problems.message: A cycle of requirements: Boros → Ouro → Boros. None of them can ever be gained while each requires the next.
Blueprint items branch from each other in a loop: Loop One → Loop Two → Loop One. Each item can branch from only one that comes before it.
Iron Fortress requires both Iron Stance and Ember Stance, which are mutually exclusive, so it can never be gained.
Tail Whip can never be gained: it requires Boros, which can never be gained.
Nova’s requirement rule “levl >= 5” cannot be read: Nothing here is called “levl”.
A loop of upgrades, evolutions, fusions or replacements: Knight → Squire → Knight. It may be meant (a form taken and left again); it is said here so it is not missed.
Inferno is fused from Fire Lance alone. A fusion is usually of two or more: add the others, or record it as an upgrade or evolution.
Solo Fusion is fused from Palm Strike alone. A fusion is usually of two or more: add the others, or record it as an upgrade or evolution.
Mira holds both Iron Stance and Ember Stance, which are mutually exclusive.
Mira holds Flame Wall without Fire Lance, which it requires.
